references.text: Moses instructs the Israelites not to add to or take away from the commandments they have received, which may reflect the idea of contentment and restraint in Mark 6:9.
Jesus gives similar instructions to his disciples in the Gospel of Matthew, emphasizing the importance of simplicity and trust in God's provision.
Luke provides a parallel account to Mark 6:9, where Jesus instructs the disciples on what to take with them on their journey, highlighting the theme of dependence on God rather than material goods.
Paul and Barnabas wear sandals during their missionary journey, which can be seen as a practical application of Jesus' instructions in Mark 6:9.
